extraction_scope: worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology summary from primary Results/Discussion, Figures 2-5 captions, and methods; no unsupported quantitative image values are promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AFM images and source text support membrane-damage morphology for selected analog treatments: loss of rod shape, disintegration, and cytoplasmic-content leakage in S. typhi, E. coli, and P. aeruginosa after treatment at stated multiples/concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RLFP-4 (8), RLFP-3 (6), RLFP-1 (4), RSP-1 (3), and RSP-4 (7) in the organism/figure-specific conditions reported by Figures 2-4.
direct_assay_types: atomic force microscopy morphology after peptide treatment
mechanism_claims.limitations: AFM supports membrane-damage morphology under tested conditions; it does not by itself prove a molecular target or quantify membrane permeabilization kinetics.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD/Bestsel data support alpha-helical secondary-structure context for the peptide analogs in SDS; this is mechanism context rather than direct killing-mechanism proof.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Secondary-structure percentages are contextual and are not promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Discussion claims about lysine/LPS or anti-inflammatory motifs are literature rationale for design and are not primary direct mechanism assays for the analogs in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No paper-local LPS binding, endotoxin neutralization, receptor, or immune assay is reported for these analogs.
